bool text_less(string a, string b)
    int[] first := a.codepoints()
    int[] second := b.codepoints()
    count := if #first < #second then #first else #second
    for: i < count
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return #first < #second

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool contains_word(string[] items, string value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

string[] unique_words(string[] items)
    string[] result := []
    for item := items.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != item
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

nat position(string[] items, string value)
    for: item := items[i]
        if item == value
            return i
    return #items

int parse_time(string text)
    return int(text[:<2]) * 60 + int(text[3:])

string clock_text(int value)
    hour := string(value / 60)
    minute := string(value % 60)
    return (if #hour == 1 then "0" else "") + hour + ":" + (if #minute == 1 then "0" else "") + minute

int half_price(int value)
    return ((value + 19) / 20) * 10

string segment_key(string first, string second)
    return if text_less(first, second) then first + "-" + second else second + "-" + first

class Station(string id, nat zone, string name)
    transfer := 0
    closed := false
    walks := map<string, int>()

class TransitLine(string id, int first, int last, int headway, string[] stops, int[] offsets)
    delay := 0
    suspended := false

    int trips()
        return (last - first) / headway + 1

class Direction(TransitLine service, string[] stops, int[] offsets)
    int train_time(int train, nat at)
        return service.first + service.delay + train * service.headway + offsets[at]

    int first_train(nat at, int ready)
        int delta := ready - train_time(0, at)
        train := if delta <= 0 then 0 else (delta + service.headway - 1) / service.headway
        return if train < service.trips() then train else -1

    int[] upcoming(nat at, int ready, nat count)
        int train := first_train(at, ready)
        int[] result := []
        if train >= 0
            while train < service.trips() and #result < count
                result = result.append(train)
                train += 1
        return result

Direction[] directions(TransitLine service)
    total := service.offsets[-1]
    return [Direction(service, service.stops, service.offsets), Direction(service, service.stops[::-1], [for offset := service.offsets[::-1][] then total - offset])]

class Leg(string kind, string line_id, string terminal, string origin, int start, string destination, int finish, nat stops)
class Label(timestamp := -1, Leg[] journey := [])
class Labels()
    data := map<string, Label>()

    Label get_label(string name)
        match data.get(name)
            Label value
                return value
            none
                return Label()

    bool improves(string name, int arrival)
        Label old := get_label(name)
        return old.timestamp < 0 or arrival < old.timestamp

    void .put_label(string name, Label value)
        .data.set(name, value)

class WalkResult(Labels labels, string[] changed)
class Option(nat rides, Label label)
class Ticket(Leg leg, nat zones, int price, int discount)
class Passing(int timestamp, string line_id, nat order, Direction direction)

Leg make_ride(Direction route, int train, nat first, nat last)
    return Leg("ride", route.service.id, route.stops[-1], route.stops[first], route.train_time(train, first), route.stops[last], route.train_time(train, last), last - first)

nat ride_count(Leg[] journey)
    return #[for leg := journey[] if leg.kind == "ride" then leg]

void journey_report(string heading, int departure, Label value)
    rides := ride_count(value.journey)
    walks := #[for leg := value.journey[] if leg.kind == "walk" then leg]
    emit("{heading} {clock_text(departure)} -> {clock_text(value.timestamp)} total {value.timestamp - departure} rides {rides} walks {walks}")
    previous := departure
    for leg := value.journey[]
        if leg.kind == "ride"
            emit("RIDE {leg.line_id} toward {leg.terminal} {leg.origin} {clock_text(leg.start)} -> {leg.destination} {clock_text(leg.finish)} wait {leg.start - previous} stops {leg.stops}")
        elif leg.kind == "walk"
            emit("WALK {leg.origin} {clock_text(leg.start)} -> {leg.destination} {clock_text(leg.finish)}")
        else
            emit("STAY {leg.origin} {clock_text(leg.start)} -> {clock_text(leg.finish)}")
        previous = leg.finish

class Planner()
    stations := map<string, Station>()
    services := map<string, TransitLine>()
    closed_segments := map<string, bool>()
    discount := 0
    window := 0
    int[] prices := []

    Station get_station(string id)
        match stations.get(id)
            Station value
                return value
            none
                return Station(id, 1, "")

    TransitLine get_service(string id)
        match services.get(id)
            TransitLine value
                return value
            none
                return TransitLine(id, 0, 0, 1, [], [])

    void | error check_station(string id)
        if not stations.has(id)
            return error("unknown station {id}")
        return void

    void | error check_service(string id)
        if not services.has(id)
            return error("unknown line {id}")
        return void

    void | error check_open(string id)
        if get_station(id).closed
            return error("station {id} is closed")
        return void

    void | error endpoints(string origin, string destination)
        try check_station(origin)
        try check_station(destination)
        if origin == destination
            return error("origin and destination are the same")
        try check_open(origin)
        try check_open(destination)
        return void

    Direction | error toward(TransitLine service, string terminal)
        if terminal != service.stops[0] and terminal != service.stops[-1]
            return error("{terminal} is not a terminal of line {service.id}")
        return directions(service)[if terminal == service.stops[-1] then 0 else 1]

    bool blocked(string first, string second)
        return closed_segments.has(segment_key(first, second))

    TransitLine[] ordered_services(active := false)
        return [for id := services.keys().sorted()[] if not active or not get_service(id).suspended then get_service(id)]

    int ready_time(string origin, string name, int arrival)
        return arrival + (if origin == name then 0 else get_station(name).transfer)

    WalkResult walk_from(Labels initial, string name, Label source)
        result := initial
        string[] changed := []
        Station station := get_station(name)
        for neighbor := station.walks.keys().sorted()[]
            minutes := 0
            match station.walks.get(neighbor)
                int value
                    minutes = value
                none
                    void
            arrival := source.timestamp + minutes
            if not get_station(neighbor).closed and arrival <= 1440 and result.improves(neighbor, arrival)
                leg := Leg("walk", "", "", name, source.timestamp, neighbor, arrival, 0)
                .result.put_label(neighbor, Label(arrival, source.journey.append(leg)))
                changed = changed.append(neighbor)
        return WalkResult(result, changed)

    Labels ride_from(Labels initial, Direction route, string name, int ready, Leg[] journey)
        result := initial
        at := position(route.stops, name)
        if at >= #route.stops - 1
            return result
        train := route.first_train(at, ready)
        if train < 0
            return result
        for: at + 1 <= j < #route.stops
            stop := route.stops[j]
            if blocked(route.stops[j - 1], stop)
                break
            if get_station(stop).closed
                continue
            arrival := route.train_time(train, j)
            if result.improves(stop, arrival)
                .result.put_label(stop, Label(arrival, journey.append(make_ride(route, train, at, j))))
        return result

    Labels earliest(string origin, int departure)
        result := Labels()
        .result.put_label(origin, Label(departure))
        string[] settled := []
        TransitLine[] active := ordered_services(true)
        while true
            selected := ""
            timestamp := -1
            for name := result.data.keys().sorted()[]
                if not contains_word(settled, name)
                    candidate := result.get_label(name).timestamp
                    if timestamp < 0 or candidate < timestamp
                        selected = name
                        timestamp = candidate
            if selected == ""
                return result
            settled = settled.append(selected)
            source := result.get_label(selected)
            int ready := ready_time(origin, selected, timestamp)
            for service := active[]
                for route := directions(service)[]
                    result = ride_from(result, route, selected, ready, source.journey)
            result = walk_from(result, selected, source).labels

    WalkResult walk_step(Labels initial, string[] starts, string[] marked)
        result := initial
        changed := marked
        for name := unique_words(starts)[]
            WalkResult step := walk_from(result, name, initial.get_label(name))
            result = step.labels
            changed = changed.concat(step.changed)
        return WalkResult(result, unique_words(changed))

    WalkResult ride_round(string origin, Direction route, Labels previous, string[] marked, Labels initial, string[] ridden)
        result := initial
        changed := ridden
        train := -1
        nat board := 0
        Leg[] journey := []
        for: name := route.stops[j]
            if j > 0 and blocked(route.stops[j - 1], name)
                train = -1
            if get_station(name).closed
                continue
            if train >= 0
                arrival := route.train_time(train, j)
                if result.improves(name, arrival)
                    .result.put_label(name, Label(arrival, journey.append(make_ride(route, train, board, j))))
                    changed = changed.append(name)
            if j + 1 < #route.stops and contains_word(marked, name)
                source := previous.get_label(name)
                next := route.first_train(j, ready_time(origin, name, source.timestamp))
                if next >= 0 and (train < 0 or next < train)
                    train = next
                    board = j
                    journey = source.journey
        return WalkResult(result, unique_words(changed))

    Labels[] round_search(string origin, int departure)
        result := Labels()
        .result.put_label(origin, Label(departure))
        WalkResult initial := walk_step(result, [origin], [origin])
        result = initial.labels
        marked := initial.changed
        rounds := [result]
        TransitLine[] active := ordered_services(true)
        while #marked != 0
            previous := result
            previous_marked := marked
            string[] ridden := []
            for service := active[]
                for route := directions(service)[]
                    WalkResult step := ride_round(origin, route, previous, previous_marked, result, ridden)
                    result = step.labels
                    ridden = step.changed
            WalkResult step := walk_step(result, ridden, ridden)
            result = step.labels
            marked = step.changed
            rounds = rounds.append(result)
        return rounds

    string stop_flags(string[] stops, nat at)
        return (if get_station(stops[at]).closed then " closed" else "") + (if at > 0 and blocked(stops[at - 1], stops[at]) then " blocked" else "")

    Ticket[] fare_items(Leg[] journey, bool child)
        cap := if child then half_price(discount) else discount
        previous := -1
        Ticket[] result := []
        for leg := journey[]
            if leg.kind != "ride"
                continue
            Direction route := toward(get_service(leg.line_id), leg.terminal)
            at := position(route.stops, leg.origin)
            nat[] zones := []
            for: at <= j <= at + leg.stops
                nat zone := get_station(route.stops[j]).zone
                found := false
                for value := zones[]
                    if value == zone
                        found = true
                if not found
                    zones = zones.append(zone)
            price_index := if #zones <= #prices then #zones - 1 else #prices - 1
            price := if child then half_price(prices[price_index]) else prices[price_index]
            reduction := if previous >= 0 and leg.start - previous <= window then (if cap < price then cap else price) else 0
            result = result.append(Ticket(leg, #zones, price, reduction))
            previous = leg.finish
        return result

    Passing[] passing_trains(string name, int timestamp, nat count, bool arriving)
        Passing[] result := []
        for service := ordered_services(true)[]
            if not contains_word(service.stops, name)
                continue
            for: route := directions(service)[order]
                at := position(route.stops, name)
                if (arriving and at == 0) or (not arriving and at + 1 == #route.stops)
                    continue
                for train := route.upcoming(at, timestamp, count)[]
                    item := Passing(route.train_time(train, at), service.id, order, route)
                    nat index := 0
                    while index < #result and (result[index].timestamp < item.timestamp or (result[index].timestamp == item.timestamp and (text_less(result[index].line_id, item.line_id) or (result[index].line_id == item.line_id and result[index].order <= item.order))))
                        index += 1
                    result = result[:<index].append(item).concat(result[index:])
        selected := if #result < count then #result else count
        return result[:<selected]

    void | error .execute(string text)
        words := text.split(" ")
        command := words[0]
        args := words[1:]
        if command == "STATION"
            id := args[0]
            if stations.has(id)
                return error("station {id} already exists")
            .stations.set(id, Station(id, nat(args[1]), args[2]))
            emit("STATION {id} zone {args[1]} {args[2]}")
        elif command == "LINE"
            id := args[0]
            if services.has(id)
                return error("line {id} already exists")
            stops := args[4::2]
            for name := stops[]
                try check_station(name)
            string[] seen := []
            for name := stops[]
                if contains_word(seen, name)
                    return error("station {name} appears twice on line {id}")
                seen = seen.append(name)
            first := parse_time(args[1])
            last := parse_time(args[2])
            if first > last
                return error("line {id} first departure is after last departure")
            offsets := [0]
            for word := args[5::2][]
                offsets = offsets.append(offsets[-1] + int(word))
            total := offsets[-1]
            if last + total > 1440
                return error("line {id} runs past 24:00")
            value := TransitLine(id, first, last, int(args[3]), stops, offsets)
            .services.set(id, value)
            emit("LINE {id} stops {#stops} time {total} trips {value.trips()}")
        elif command == "TRANSFER"
            try check_station(args[0])
            Station value := get_station(args[0])
            value.transfer = int(args[1])
            .stations.set(args[0], value)
            emit("TRANSFER {args[0]} {args[1]}")
        elif command == "WALK"
            try check_station(args[0])
            try check_station(args[1])
            if args[0] == args[1]
                return error("walk from {args[0]} to itself")
            Station first := get_station(args[0])
            Station second := get_station(args[1])
            suffix := ""
            match first.walks.get(args[1])
                int old
                    suffix = " was {old}"
                none
                    void
            minutes := int(args[2])
            .first.walks.set(args[1], minutes)
            .second.walks.set(args[0], minutes)
            .stations.set(args[0], first)
            .stations.set(args[1], second)
            emit("WALK {args[0]} {args[1]} {minutes}{suffix}")
        elif command == "TARIFF"
            int[] new_prices := [for word := args[2:][] then int(word)]
            for: 1 <= i < #new_prices
                if new_prices[i] < new_prices[i - 1]
                    return error("tariff prices must not decrease")
            discount = int(args[0])
            window = int(args[1])
            prices = new_prices
            emit("TARIFF zones {#prices} discount {discount} window {window}")
        elif command == "CLOSE" or command == "OPEN"
            try check_station(args[0])
            closing := command == "CLOSE"
            if #args == 1
                Station value := get_station(args[0])
                if value.closed == closing
                    return error("station {args[0]} is " + (if closing then "already closed" else "not closed"))
                value.closed = closing
                .stations.set(args[0], value)
                emit("{command} {args[0]}")
            else
                try check_station(args[1])
                key := segment_key(args[0], args[1])
                label := "{args[0]}-{args[1]}"
                if closing
                    string[] affected := []
                    for service := ordered_services()[]
                        for: 1 <= i < #service.stops
                            if segment_key(service.stops[i - 1], service.stops[i]) == key
                                affected = affected.append(service.id)
                                break
                    if #affected == 0
                        return error("no segment {label}")
                    if closed_segments.has(key)
                        return error("segment {label} is already closed")
                    .closed_segments.set(key, true)
                    emit("CLOSE {label} lines {affected.join(" ")}")
                else
                    if not closed_segments.has(key)
                        return error("segment {label} is not closed")
                    bool removed := .closed_segments.remove(key)
                    emit("OPEN {label}")
        elif command == "DELAY" or command == "SUSPEND" or command == "RESUME"
            try check_service(args[0])
            TransitLine value := get_service(args[0])
            if command == "DELAY"
                minutes := int(args[1])
                if value.last + minutes + value.offsets[-1] > 1440
                    return error("line {args[0]} runs past 24:00")
                value.delay = minutes
                emit("DELAY {args[0]} {minutes}")
            else
                suspend := command == "SUSPEND"
                if value.suspended == suspend
                    return error("line {args[0]} is " + (if suspend then "already suspended" else "not suspended"))
                value.suspended = suspend
                emit("{command} {args[0]}")
            .services.set(args[0], value)
        elif command == "VIA"
            origin := args[0]
            via := args[1]
            destination := args[2]
            try check_station(origin)
            try check_station(via)
            try check_station(destination)
            if origin == destination
                return error("origin and destination are the same")
            if via == origin or via == destination
                return error("via station {via} must differ from origin and destination")
            try check_open(origin)
            try check_open(via)
            try check_open(destination)
            departure := parse_time(args[3])
            heading := "VIA {origin} {via} {destination}"
            Label first := earliest(origin, departure).get_label(via)
            if first.timestamp >= 0
                int resume := first.timestamp + get_station(via).transfer
                Label second := earliest(via, resume).get_label(destination)
                if second.timestamp >= 0
                    stay := Leg("stay", "", "", via, first.timestamp, via, resume, 0)
                    journey_report(heading, departure, Label(second.timestamp, first.journey.append(stay).concat(second.journey)))
                    return
            emit("{heading} {args[3]} unreachable")
        elif command == "ROUTE" or command == "FEWEST" or command == "PARETO" or command == "FARE" or command == "LASTTRAIN" or command == "ARRIVEBY" or command == "PROFILE"
            origin := args[0]
            destination := args[1]
            try endpoints(origin, destination)
            if command == "FARE"
                if args[3] != "ADULT" and args[3] != "CHILD"
                    return error("unknown fare class {args[3]}")
                if #prices == 0
                    return error("no tariff")
            if command == "LASTTRAIN" or command == "ARRIVEBY"
                deadline := if command == "LASTTRAIN" then 1440 else parse_time(args[2])
                heading := if command == "LASTTRAIN" then "LASTTRAIN {origin} {destination}" else "ARRIVEBY {origin} {destination} by {args[2]}"
                for: deadline > departure >= 0
                    Label value := earliest(origin, departure).get_label(destination)
                    if value.timestamp >= 0 and value.timestamp <= deadline
                        journey_report(heading, departure, value)
                        return
                emit("{heading} none")
                return
            departure := parse_time(args[2])
            heading := "{command} {origin} {destination}"
            if command == "PROFILE"
                finish := parse_time(args[3])
                if departure > finish
                    return error("empty interval {args[2]} {args[3]}")
                int[] arrivals := []
                for: departure <= timestamp <= finish
                    arrivals = arrivals.append(earliest(origin, timestamp).get_label(destination).timestamp)
                nat[] chosen := []
                for: i < #arrivals
                    if arrivals[i] >= 0 and (i + 1 == #arrivals or arrivals[i + 1] < 0 or arrivals[i] < arrivals[i + 1])
                        chosen = chosen.append(i)
                emit("{heading} {args[2]} {args[3]} count {#chosen}")
                for i := chosen[]
                    timestamp := departure + int(i)
                    emit("{clock_text(timestamp)} -> {clock_text(arrivals[i])} total {arrivals[i] - timestamp}")
            elif command == "FEWEST" or command == "PARETO"
                Labels[] rounds := round_search(origin, departure)
                Option[] options := []
                previous := -1
                for: labels := rounds[k]
                    value := labels.get_label(destination)
                    if value.timestamp >= 0
                        if previous < 0 or value.timestamp < previous
                            options = options.append(Option(k, value))
                        previous = value.timestamp
                if command == "PARETO"
                    emit("{heading} {args[2]} options {#options}")
                    for option := options[]
                        journey_report("OPTION trips {option.rides}", departure, option.label)
                elif #options == 0
                    emit("{heading} {args[2]} unreachable")
                else
                    journey_report("{heading} trips {options[0].rides}", departure, options[0].label)
            else
                Label value := earliest(origin, departure).get_label(destination)
                if value.timestamp < 0
                    emit("{heading} {args[2]}" + (if command == "FARE" then " {args[3]}" else "") + " unreachable")
                elif command == "ROUTE"
                    journey_report(heading, departure, value)
                else
                    Ticket[] tickets := fare_items(value.journey, args[3] == "CHILD")
                    total := 0
                    for ticket := tickets[]
                        total += ticket.price - ticket.discount
                    emit("{heading} {args[2]} {args[3]} rides {#tickets} total {total}")
                    for ticket := tickets[]
                        emit("TICKET {ticket.leg.line_id} {ticket.leg.origin} {ticket.leg.destination} zones {ticket.zones} price {ticket.price} discount {ticket.discount} pay {ticket.price - ticket.discount}")
        elif command == "REACH"
            try check_station(args[0])
            try check_open(args[0])
            departure := parse_time(args[1])
            int limit := departure + int(args[2])
            Labels result := earliest(args[0], departure)
            string[] selected := []
            for name := result.data.keys().sorted()[]
                if result.get_label(name).timestamp <= limit
                    nat at := 0
                    while at < #selected and result.get_label(selected[at]).timestamp <= result.get_label(name).timestamp
                        at += 1
                    selected = selected[:<at].append(name).concat(selected[at:])
            emit("REACH {args[0]} {args[1]} {args[2]} count {#selected}")
            for name := selected[]
                value := result.get_label(name)
                emit("{name} {get_station(name).name} {clock_text(value.timestamp)} {value.timestamp - departure} rides {ride_count(value.journey)}")
        elif command == "TIMETABLE"
            try check_station(args[0])
            try check_service(args[1])
            TransitLine service := get_service(args[1])
            if not contains_word(service.stops, args[0])
                return error("station {args[0]} is not on line {args[1]}")
            Direction route := try toward(service, args[2])
            if args[0] == args[2]
                return error("no departures from {args[0]} toward {args[2]}")
            if service.suspended
                return error("line {args[1]} is suspended")
            try check_open(args[0])
            at := position(route.stops, args[0])
            times := [for train := route.upcoming(at, parse_time(args[3]), nat(args[4]))[] then clock_text(route.train_time(train, at))]
            emit("TIMETABLE {args[0]} {args[1]} toward {args[2]} {args[3]} next {#times}" + (if #times == 0 then "" else " {times.join(" ")}"))
        elif command == "DEPARTURES" or command == "ARRIVALS"
            try check_station(args[0])
            try check_open(args[0])
            arriving := command == "ARRIVALS"
            Passing[] selected := passing_trains(args[0], parse_time(args[1]), nat(args[2]), arriving)
            emit("{command} {args[0]} {args[1]} count {#selected}")
            for item := selected[]
                terminal := if arriving then item.direction.stops[0] else item.direction.stops[-1]
                emit("{clock_text(item.timestamp)} {item.line_id} " + (if arriving then "from " else "toward ") + terminal)
        elif command == "TRIP" or command == "SHOWLINE"
            try check_service(args[0])
            TransitLine service := get_service(args[0])
            if command == "SHOWLINE"
                state := if service.suspended then "suspended" else "running"
                emit("SHOWLINE {service.id} {state} first {clock_text(service.first)} last {clock_text(service.last)} headway {service.headway} delay {service.delay} trips {service.trips()}")
                for: name := service.stops[j]
                    emit("{service.offsets[j]} {name} zone {get_station(name).zone}{stop_flags(service.stops, j)}")
            else
                Direction route := try toward(service, args[1])
                if service.suspended
                    return error("line {service.id} is suspended")
                train := route.first_train(0, parse_time(args[2]))
                heading := "TRIP {service.id} toward {args[1]} {args[2]}"
                if train < 0
                    emit("{heading} none")
                else
                    emit("{heading} trip {train + 1} departs {clock_text(route.train_time(train, 0))}")
                    for: name := route.stops[j]
                        emit("{clock_text(route.train_time(train, j))} {name}{stop_flags(route.stops, j)}")
        elif command == "INFO"
            try check_station(args[0])
            Station value := get_station(args[0])
            emit("INFO {value.id} {value.name} zone {value.zone} transfer {value.transfer} " + (if value.closed then "closed" else "open"))
            string[] lines := [for service := ordered_services()[] if contains_word(service.stops, value.id) then service.id]
            emit("LINES " + (if #lines == 0 then "none" else lines.join(" ")))
            string[] walks := []
            for name := value.walks.keys().sorted()[]
                match value.walks.get(name)
                    int minutes
                        walks = walks.append("{name} {minutes}")
                    none
                        void
            emit("WALKS " + (if #walks == 0 then "none" else walks.join(" ")))
        elif command == "STATUS"
            nat walks := 0
            for value := stations.values()[]
                walks += value.walks.size()
            emit("STATUS stations {stations.size()} lines {services.size()} walks {walks / 2}")
            for id := stations.keys().sorted()[]
                if get_station(id).closed
                    emit("CLOSED {id}")
            for key := closed_segments.keys().sorted()[]
                emit("CLOSED {key}")
            for service := ordered_services()[]
                if service.suspended
                    emit("SUSPENDED {service.id}")
            for service := ordered_services()[]
                if service.delay != 0
                    emit("DELAYED {service.id} {service.delay}")
        return void

planner := Planner()
nat count
scan(&count)
for: i < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match .planner.execute(line)
        void
            void
        error issue
            emit("ERROR {issue.message}")
